description: This file contains a unit test class 'EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPITest' for the 'EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPI' class in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, and includes tests for retrieving attendance summaries, as well as placeholder tests for creating and deleting summaries, which are expected to throw not implemented exceptions.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeAttendanceSummaryAPI endpoints and behaviors within the OrangeHRM attendance module.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data before any tests are run, by populating required YAML fixture files.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the API with different test cases provided by the data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for 'testGetAll', sourcing from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Confirms that calling 'create' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that 'delete' method throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a 'not implemented' exception.
